cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says consumer-protection rules for digital finance are in force, or reports a fine or sanction under them; a conduct standard for payment services was being drafted in 2025.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-10-26: The National Financial Ombud takes complaints about mobile and internet banking fraud, which answers question 3. No consumer-protection rule for digital finance in force has been found, so its fraud figures are not read as enforcement under one.
